name: North portal (Nether side)
notes: Comes out in a warped forest — no hostile spawns except endermen. Overworld side is the North cabin at (-201, -1667). Open warped-forest floor around (-22, -243) with a basalt pillar nearby.

name: North portal 2 (Nether side)
